key_insight: An AI-assisted pipeline improves evaluation of research-level mathematical proofs across natural language, CAS code, and Lean formalizations.
engineering_relevance: The approach offers a methodology for evaluating complex mathematical reasoning and supporting code at scale in AI-for-science workflows.
method: Analyze Ramanujan Challenge submissions on research-level number theory problems.
Evaluate semantic and logical correctness across natural language proofs, CAS code, and Lean formalizations.
Compare pipeline judgments with conventional one-shot LLM judgments.
evidence_signal: The pipeline reduced false-positive verdicts on natural language proofs from 23% to 6% and increased supporting-code judgment accuracy from 46% to 58%.
watch_item: Supporting-code judgment accuracy remains only 58%, and generalization beyond this number theory benchmark is not established in the abstract.
paper_title: Ramanujan Challenge Results: AI-Assisted Evaluation Pipeline for Multi-Format Proofs
